controls.title: Centralised event logging
controls.description: Security-relevant event logs and configuration changes for systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications and data) are centrally collected, protected against unauthorised modification or deletion, and retained to support effective cyber security event detection and investigation.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-det-01
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Detect cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Cyber security event detection
controls.description: Anomalous or unexpected events and behaviours for systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications and data) are analysed in a timely manner to detect cyber security events.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-det-02
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Detect cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Cyber security incident identification
controls.description: Cyber security events are analysed in a timely manner to identify cyber security incidents.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-det-03
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Detect cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Baselined high-risk access activities
controls.description: Baseline patterns of identity and credential access activities, privileged access activities, and remote access activities are established and maintained for systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications and data) to enable the detection of anomalous or unexpected behaviour.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-det-04
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Detect cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Detection capability efficacy
controls.description: Cyber security event detection capabilities are regularly evaluated for effectiveness and continuously refined, including by using current strategic and sector-specific cyber threat intelligence, to improve the detection of cyber security events.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-det-05
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Detect cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Executive cyber security accountability
controls.description: The board of directors or executive committee is accountable for cyber security.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-gov-01
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Govern cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Cyber security leadership
controls.description: A chief information security officer provides leadership and oversight of cyber security activities and delivers regular and timely risk-based reporting to the board of directors or executive committee on their organisation's cyber security posture, the effectiveness of controls, current security risks and emerging cyber threats.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-gov-02
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Govern cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Security risk management assurance
controls.description: Security risk management activities for an organisation and their systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications and data) are embedded into organisational risk management frameworks and subject to ongoing monitoring and assurance activities by the board of directors or executive committee.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-gov-03
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Govern cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Cyber security resourcing
controls.description: Suitable and sufficient personnel and resources are identified, acquired and maintained in support of cyber security activities.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-gov-04
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Govern cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Security risk acceptance
controls.description: Residual security risks for systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications and data), including inherited and shared security risks, are accepted before they are authorised for use and continuously monitored and managed throughout their operational life.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-gov-05
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Govern cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Security risk communication
controls.description: Residual security risks for systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications and data), including inherited and shared security risks, are transparently and mutually communicated with stakeholders.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-gov-06
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Govern cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Continuous cyber security improvement
controls.description: Security risk management and associated cyber security activities are continually measured and reviewed using cyber threat intelligence and assurance activities, including exercises informed by real-world cyber threats, to identify, prioritise and incorporate improvements in governance arrangements, shared responsibilities and the effectiveness of controls.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-gov-07
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Govern cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Executive artificial intelligence accountability
controls.description: The board of directors or executive committee is accountable for ensuring that artificial intelligence is secure, controllable, human-supervised and used in an ethical and accountable manner.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-gov-08
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Govern cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Security risk management responsibilities
controls.description: Security risk management responsibilities for an organisation and their suppliers, partners and customers, including any shared responsibilities, are documented and communicated to all relevant parties with accountability arrangements in place to ensure their effective implementation.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-gov-09
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Govern cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: System exposure minimisation
controls.description: Information about the design, configuration and operation of systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications and data) is not publicly disclosed or shared externally unless necessary for commercial, legal, regulatory or security purposes, with any disclosure minimised, controlled and logged.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-gov-10
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Govern cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Supplier cyber security assurance
controls.description: Systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications and data) are delivered and supported by trustworthy suppliers whose cyber security practices are independently verified, or otherwise risk-assessed, on a regular basis.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-gov-11
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Govern cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Personnel suitability assurance
controls.description: Only personnel whose suitability and trustworthiness have been established, and are subject to ongoing assurance, are granted access to systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications and data).
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-gov-12
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Govern cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Cyber security and safety
controls.description: Controls for systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications and data) do not compromise human, physical or environmental safety.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-gov-13
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Govern cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Legacy system management
controls.description: Systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications and data) that are not capable of meeting cyber security requirements are managed using compensating controls, along with enhanced monitoring and assurance activities, to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until they can be decommissioned or replaced.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-gov-14
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Govern cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Asset identification
controls.description: Systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications, identities, credentials and data) are continually and centrally identified and documented.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-ide-01
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Identify cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Business criticality rating identification
controls.description: Business criticality ratings for systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications and data) are identified and documented.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-ide-02
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Identify cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Security requirement identification
controls.description: Security requirements for systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications and data) are identified and documented.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-ide-03
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Identify cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Security risk identification
controls.description: Security risks for an organisation and their systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications and data) are identified, including by using current strategic and sector-specific cyber threat intelligence and threat modelling, and are documented along with any associated risk management decisions.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-ide-04
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Identify cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Asset interdependencies
controls.description: Interdependencies between systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications and data) are continually and centrally identified and documented, including how the compromise of one system could affect the security or business operations of other dependent systems.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-ide-05
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Identify cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Resilience requirement identification
controls.description: Resilience requirements for systems (infrastructure, operating systems, applications and data) are identified and documented.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-principle-ide-06
controls.category: Cyber security principles / The cyber security principles / Identify cyber security principles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0009
controls.description: System owners, in consultation with each system's authorising officer, identify any supplementary controls required based upon the unique nature of each system, its operating environment and the organisation's risk tolerances.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0009
controls.category: Guidelines for cyber security roles / System owners / Protecting systems and their resources
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0027
controls.description: System owners obtain an authorisation to operate for each non-classified, OFFICIAL: Sensitive, PROTECTED and SECRET system from its authorising officer.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0027
controls.category: Guidelines for cyber security roles / System owners / Protecting systems and their resources
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S

controls.title: Control: ism-0039
controls.family: Development and maintenance of cyber security documentation
controls.description: A cyber security strategy is developed, implemented and maintained.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0039
controls.category: Guidelines for cyber security documentation / Development and maintenance of cyber security documentation / Cyber security strategy
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0041
controls.description: Systems have a system security plan that includes an overview of the system (covering the system's purpose, the system boundary and how the system is managed) as well as an annex that covers applicable controls from this document and any additional controls that have been identified and implemented.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0041
controls.category: Guidelines for cyber security documentation / System-specific cyber security documentation / System security plan
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0042
controls.description: System administration processes, and supporting system administration procedures, are developed, implemented and maintained.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0042
controls.category: Guidelines for system management / System administration / System administration processes and procedures
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0043
controls.description: Systems have a cyber security incident response plan that covers the following: - guidelines on what constitutes a cyber security incident - the types of cyber security incidents likely to be encountered and the expected response to each type - how to report cyber security incidents, internally to an organisation and externally to relevant authorities - other parties which need to be informed in the event of a cyber security incident - the authority, or authorities, responsible for investigating and responding to cyber security incidents - the criteria by which an investigation of a cyber security incident would be requested from a law enforcement agency, the Australian Signals Directorate or other relevant authority - the steps necessary to ensure the integrity of evidence relating to a cyber security incident - system contingency measures or a reference to such details if they are located in a separate document.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0043
controls.category: Guidelines for cyber security documentation / System-specific cyber security documentation / Cyber security incident response plan
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0047
controls.family: Development and maintenance of cyber security documentation
controls.description: Organisational-level cyber security documentation is approved by the chief information security officer while system-specific cyber security documentation is approved by the system's authorising officer.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0047
controls.category: Guidelines for cyber security documentation / Development and maintenance of cyber security documentation / Approval of cyber security documentation
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0072
controls.description: Security requirements associated with the confidentiality, integrity and availability of data are documented in contractual arrangements with service providers and reviewed on a regular and ongoing basis to ensure they remain fit for purpose.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0072
controls.category: Guidelines for procurement and outsourcing / Managed services and cloud services / Contractual security requirements with service providers
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0078
controls.family: Access to systems and their resources
controls.description: Systems processing, storing or communicating AUSTEO or AGAO data remain at all times under the control of an Australian national working for or on behalf of the Australian Government.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0078
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Access to systems and their resources / Control of Australian systems
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0100
controls.description: Non-classified, OFFICIAL: Sensitive, PROTECTED and SECRET gateways undergo an IRAP assessment, using the latest release of the ISM available prior to the beginning of the IRAP assessment (or a subsequent release), at least every 24 months.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0100
controls.category: Guidelines for gateways / Gateways / Assessment of gateways
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S

controls.title: Control: ism-0109
controls.description: Event logs from workstations are analysed in a timely manner to detect cyber security events.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0109
controls.category: Guidelines for system monitoring / Event logging and monitoring / Event log monitoring
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0120
controls.description: Cyber security personnel have access to sufficient data sources and tools to ensure that systems can be monitored for key indicators of compromise.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0120
controls.category: Guidelines for cyber security incidents / Managing cyber security incidents / Access to sufficient data sources and tools
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0123
controls.description: Cyber security incidents are reported to the chief information security officer, or one of their delegates, as soon as possible after they occur or are discovered.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0123
controls.category: Guidelines for cyber security incidents / Managing cyber security incidents / Reporting cyber security incidents
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0125
controls.description: A cyber security incident register is developed, implemented and maintained.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0125
controls.category: Guidelines for cyber security incidents / Managing cyber security incidents / Cyber security incident register
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0133
controls.description: When a data spill occurs, data owners are advised and access to the data is restricted.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0133
controls.category: Guidelines for cyber security incidents / Responding to cyber security incidents / Handling and containing data spills
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0137
controls.description: Legal advice is sought before allowing intrusion activity to continue on a system for the purpose of collecting further data or evidence.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0137
controls.category: Guidelines for cyber security incidents / Responding to cyber security incidents / Handling and containing intrusions
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0138
controls.description: The integrity of evidence gathered during an investigation is maintained by investigators: - recording all of their actions - maintaining a proper chain of custody - following all instructions provided by relevant law enforcement agencies.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0138
controls.category: Guidelines for cyber security incidents / Responding to cyber security incidents / Maintaining the integrity of evidence
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0140
controls.description: Cyber security incidents are reported to ASD as soon as possible after they occur or are discovered.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0140
controls.category: Guidelines for cyber security incidents / Managing cyber security incidents / Reporting cyber security incidents to ASD
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0141
controls.description: The requirement for service providers to report cyber security incidents to a designated point of contact as soon as possible after they occur or are discovered is documented in contractual arrangements with service providers.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0141
controls.category: Guidelines for procurement and outsourcing / Managed services and cloud services / Contractual security requirements with service providers
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0142
controls.description: The compromise or suspected compromise of cryptographic equipment or associated keying material is reported to the chief information security officer, or one of their delegates, as soon as possible after it occurs.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0142
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Cryptographic fundamentals / Reporting cryptographic-related cyber security incidents
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0161
controls.description: IT equipment and media are secured when not in use.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0161
controls.category: Guidelines for physical security / IT equipment and media / Securing IT equipment and media
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0164
controls.description: Unauthorised people are prevented from observing systems, in particular workstation displays and keyboards, within facilities.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0164
controls.category: Guidelines for physical security / Facilities and systems / Preventing observation by unauthorised people
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0181
controls.description: Cabling infrastructure is installed in accordance with relevant Australian Standards, as directed by the Australian Communications and Media Authority.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0181
controls.category: Guidelines for communications infrastructure / Cabling infrastructure / Cabling infrastructure standards
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0187
controls.description: SECRET cables, when bundled together or run in conduit, are run exclusively in their own individual cable bundle or conduit.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0187
controls.category: Guidelines for communications infrastructure / Cabling infrastructure / Common cable bundles and conduits
controls.applicability_notes: S

controls.title: Control: ism-0194
controls.description: In shared facilities, a visible smear of conduit glue is used to seal all plastic conduit joints and TOP SECRET conduits connected by threaded lock nuts.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0194
controls.category: Guidelines for communications infrastructure / Cabling infrastructure / Sealing cable reticulation systems and conduits
controls.applicability_notes: TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0195
controls.description: In shared facilities, uniquely identifiable SCEC-approved tamper-evident seals are used to seal all removable covers on TOP SECRET cable reticulation systems.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0195
controls.category: Guidelines for communications infrastructure / Cabling infrastructure / Sealing cable reticulation systems and conduits
controls.applicability_notes: TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0198
controls.description: When penetrating a TOP SECRET audio secure room, the Australian Security Intelligence Organisation is consulted and all directions provided are complied with.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0198
controls.category: Guidelines for communications infrastructure / Cabling infrastructure / Audio secure rooms
controls.applicability_notes: TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0201
controls.description: Labels for TOP SECRET conduits are a minimum size of 2.5 cm x 1 cm, attached at five-metre intervals and marked as 'TS RUN'.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0201
controls.category: Guidelines for communications infrastructure / Cabling infrastructure / Labelling conduits
controls.applicability_notes: TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0206
controls.description: Cable labelling processes, and supporting cable labelling procedures, are developed, implemented and maintained.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0206
controls.category: Guidelines for communications infrastructure / Cabling infrastructure / Cable labelling processes and procedures
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0208
controls.description: A cable register contains the following for each cable: - cable identifier - cable colour - sensitivity/classification - source - destination - location - seal numbers (if applicable).
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0208
controls.category: Guidelines for communications infrastructure / Cabling infrastructure / Cable register
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0211
controls.description: A cable register is developed, implemented, maintained and verified on a regular basis.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0211
controls.category: Guidelines for communications infrastructure / Cabling infrastructure / Cable register
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0213
controls.description: SECRET and TOP SECRET cables are terminated on their own individual patch panels.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0213
controls.category: Guidelines for communications infrastructure / Cabling infrastructure / Terminating cables on patch panels
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0216
controls.description: TOP SECRET patch panels are installed in individual TOP SECRET cabinets.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0216
controls.category: Guidelines for communications infrastructure / Cabling infrastructure / Physical separation of cabinets and patch panels
controls.applicability_notes: TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0217
controls.description: Where spatial constraints demand non-TOP SECRET patch panels be installed in the same cabinet as a TOP SECRET patch panel: - a physical barrier in the cabinet is provided to separate patch panels - only personnel holding a Positive Vetting security clearance have access to the cabinet - approval from the TOP SECRET system's authorising officer is obtained prior to installation.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0217
controls.category: Guidelines for communications infrastructure / Cabling infrastructure / Physical separation of cabinets and patch panels
controls.applicability_notes: TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0218
controls.description: If TOP SECRET fibre-optic fly leads exceeding five metres in length are used to connect wall outlet boxes to IT equipment, they are run in a protective and easily inspected pathway that is clearly labelled at the IT equipment end with the wall outlet box's identifier.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0218
controls.category: Guidelines for communications infrastructure / Cabling infrastructure / Fly lead installation
controls.applicability_notes: TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0225
controls.description: Unauthorised RF and IR devices are not brought into SECRET and TOP SECRET areas.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0225
controls.category: Guidelines for physical security / Facilities and systems / Bringing radio frequency and infrared devices into facilities
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0229
controls.description: Personnel are advised of the permitted sensitivity or classification of information that can be discussed over internal and external telephone systems.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0229
controls.category: Guidelines for communications systems / Telephone systems / Personnel awareness
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0230
controls.description: Personnel are advised of security risks posed by non-secure telephone systems in areas where sensitive or classified conversations can occur.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0230
controls.category: Guidelines for communications systems / Telephone systems / Personnel awareness
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0231
controls.description: When using cryptographic equipment to permit different levels of conversation for different kinds of connections, telephone systems give a visual indication of what kind of connection has been made.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0231
controls.category: Guidelines for communications systems / Telephone systems / Personnel awareness
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0232
controls.description: Telephone systems used for sensitive or classified conversations encrypt all traffic that passes over external systems.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0232
controls.category: Guidelines for communications systems / Telephone systems / Protecting conversations
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0233
controls.description: Cordless telephone handsets and headsets are not used for sensitive or classified conversations unless all communications are encrypted.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0233
controls.category: Guidelines for communications systems / Telephone systems / Cordless telephone systems
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0235
controls.description: Speakerphones are not used on telephone systems in TOP SECRET areas unless the telephone system is located in an audio secure room, the room is audio secure during conversations and only personnel involved in conversations are present in the room.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0235
controls.category: Guidelines for communications systems / Telephone systems / Speakerphones
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0236
controls.description: Off-hook audio protection features are used on telephone systems in areas where background conversations may exceed the sensitivity or classification that the telephone system is authorised for communicating.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0236
controls.category: Guidelines for communications systems / Telephone systems / Off-hook audio protection
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0240
controls.description: Paging, Multimedia Message Service, Short Message Service and messaging apps are not used to communicate sensitive or classified data.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0240
controls.category: Guidelines for enterprise mobility / Mobile device usage / Using paging, message services and messaging apps
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0245
controls.description: MFDs are not connected to digital telephone systems.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0245
controls.category: Guidelines for communications systems / Multifunction devices / Connecting multifunction devices to digital telephone systems
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0246
controls.description: When an emanation security risk assessment is required, it is sought as early as possible in a system's life cycle.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0246
controls.category: Guidelines for communications infrastructure / Emanation security / Emanation security risk assessments
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0249
controls.description: System owners deploying SECRET or TOP SECRET systems in mobile platforms, or as a deployable capability, contact ASD for an emanation security risk assessment.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0249
controls.category: Guidelines for communications infrastructure / Emanation security / Emanation security risk assessments
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0250
controls.description: IT equipment meets industry and government standards relating to electromagnetic interference/electromagnetic compatibility.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0250
controls.category: Guidelines for communications infrastructure / Emanation security / Electromagnetic interference/electromagnetic compatibility standards
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0252
controls.description: Cyber security awareness training is undertaken annually by all personnel and covers: - the purpose of the cyber security awareness training - security appointments and contacts - authorised use of systems and their resources - protection of systems and their resources - reporting of cyber security incidents and suspected compromises of systems and their resources.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0252
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Cyber security awareness training / Providing cyber security awareness training
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0258
controls.family: Access to systems and their resources
controls.description: A web usage policy is developed, implemented and maintained.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0258
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Access to systems and their resources / Web usage policy
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0260
controls.description: All web access, including that by internal servers, is conducted through web proxies.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0260
controls.category: Guidelines for gateways / Web proxies / Using web proxies
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0261
controls.description: The following details are centrally logged for websites accessed via web proxies: - web address - date and time - user - amount of data uploaded and downloaded - internal and external IP addresses.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0261
controls.category: Guidelines for gateways / Web proxies / Web proxy event logging
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0263
controls.description: TLS traffic communicated through gateways is decrypted and inspected.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0263
controls.category: Guidelines for gateways / Web content filters / Transport Layer Security filtering
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0264
controls.description: An email usage policy is developed, implemented and maintained.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0264
controls.category: Guidelines for email / Email usage / Email usage policy
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0267
controls.description: Access to non-approved webmail services is blocked.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0267
controls.category: Guidelines for email / Email usage / Webmail services
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0269
controls.description: Emails containing Australian Eyes Only, Australian Government Access Only or Releasable To data are not sent to email distribution lists unless the nationality of all members of email distribution lists can be confirmed.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0269
controls.category: Guidelines for email / Email usage / Email distribution lists
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0270
controls.description: Protective markings are applied to emails and reflect the highest sensitivity or classification of the subject, body and attachments.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0270
controls.category: Guidelines for email / Email usage / Protective markings for emails
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0271
controls.description: Protective marking tools do not automatically insert protective markings into emails.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0271
controls.category: Guidelines for email / Email usage / Protective marking tools
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0272
controls.description: Protective marking tools do not allow users to select protective markings that a system has not been authorised to process, store or communicate.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0272
controls.category: Guidelines for email / Email usage / Protective marking tools
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0280
controls.description: If procuring an evaluated product, a product that has completed a PP-based evaluation, including against all applicable PP modules (as well as a software bill of materials assessment if applicable), is selected in preference to one that has completed an EAL-based evaluation.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0280
controls.category: Guidelines for evaluated products / Evaluated product procurement / Evaluated product selection
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0285
controls.description: Evaluated products are delivered in a manner consistent with any delivery procedures defined in associated evaluation documentation.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0285
controls.category: Guidelines for evaluated products / Evaluated product procurement / Delivery of evaluated products
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0286
controls.description: When procuring high assurance information technology (IT) equipment, ASD is contacted for any equipment-specific delivery procedures.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0286
controls.category: Guidelines for evaluated products / Evaluated product procurement / Delivery of evaluated products
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0289
controls.description: Evaluated products are installed, configured, administered and operated in an evaluated configuration and in accordance with vendor guidance.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0289
controls.category: Guidelines for evaluated products / Evaluated product usage / Using evaluated products
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0290
controls.description: High assurance IT equipment is installed, configured, administered and operated in an evaluated configuration and in accordance with ASD guidance.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0290
controls.category: Guidelines for evaluated products / Evaluated product usage / Using evaluated products
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0293
controls.description: IT equipment is classified based on the highest sensitivity or classification of data that it is approved for processing, storing or communicating.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0293
controls.category: Guidelines for information technology equipment / IT equipment usage / Classifying IT equipment
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0294
controls.description: IT equipment, with the exception of high assurance IT equipment, is labelled with protective markings reflecting its sensitivity or classification.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0294
controls.category: Guidelines for information technology equipment / IT equipment usage / Labelling IT equipment
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0296
controls.description: ASD's approval is sought before applying labels to external surfaces of high assurance IT equipment.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0296
controls.category: Guidelines for information technology equipment / IT equipment usage / Labelling high assurance IT equipment
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0298
controls.description: A centralised and managed approach that maintains the integrity of patches or updates, and confirms that they have been applied successfully, is used to patch or update applications, operating systems, drivers and firmware.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0298
controls.category: Guidelines for system management / System patching / Patch management processes and procedures
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0300
controls.description: Patches, updates or other vendor mitigations for vulnerabilities in high assurance IT equipment are applied only when approved by ASD, and in doing so, using methods and timeframes prescribed by ASD.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0300
controls.category: Guidelines for system management / System patching / Mitigating known vulnerabilities
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0304
controls.description: Applications other than office productivity suites, web browsers and their extensions, email clients, PDF applications, Adobe Flash Player, and security products that are no longer supported by vendors are removed.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0304
controls.category: Guidelines for system management / System patching / Cessation of support
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0305
controls.description: Maintenance and repairs of IT equipment is carried out on site by an appropriately cleared technician.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0305
controls.category: Guidelines for information technology equipment / IT equipment maintenance and repairs / On-site maintenance and repairs
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0306
controls.description: If an appropriately cleared technician is not used to undertake maintenance or repairs of IT equipment, the technician is escorted by someone who: - is appropriately cleared and briefed - takes due care to ensure that data is not disclosed - takes all responsible measures to ensure the integrity of the IT equipment - has the authority to direct the technician - is sufficiently familiar with the IT equipment to understand the work being performed.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0306
controls.category: Guidelines for information technology equipment / IT equipment maintenance and repairs / On-site maintenance and repairs
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0307
controls.description: If an appropriately cleared technician is not used to undertake maintenance or repairs of IT equipment, the IT equipment and associated media is sanitised before maintenance or repair work is undertaken.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0307
controls.category: Guidelines for information technology equipment / IT equipment maintenance and repairs / On-site maintenance and repairs
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0310
controls.description: IT equipment maintained or repaired off site is done so at facilities approved for handling the sensitivity or classification of the IT equipment.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0310
controls.category: Guidelines for information technology equipment / IT equipment maintenance and repairs / Off-site maintenance and repairs
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0311
controls.description: IT equipment containing media is sanitised by removing the media from the IT equipment or by sanitising the media in situ.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0311
controls.category: Guidelines for information technology equipment / IT equipment sanitisation and destruction / Sanitising IT equipment
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0312
controls.description: IT equipment, including associated media, that is located overseas and has processed, stored or communicated AUSTEO or AGAO data that cannot be sanitised in situ, is returned to Australia for destruction.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0312
controls.category: Guidelines for information technology equipment / IT equipment sanitisation and destruction / Sanitising highly sensitive IT equipment
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0313
controls.description: IT equipment sanitisation processes, and supporting IT equipment sanitisation procedures, are developed, implemented and maintained.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0313
controls.category: Guidelines for information technology equipment / IT equipment sanitisation and destruction / IT equipment sanitisation processes and procedures
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0315
controls.description: High assurance IT equipment is destroyed prior to its disposal.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0315
controls.category: Guidelines for information technology equipment / IT equipment sanitisation and destruction / Destroying high assurance IT equipment
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0316
controls.description: Following sanitisation, destruction or declassification, a formal administrative decision is made to release IT equipment, or its waste, into the public domain.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0316
controls.category: Guidelines for information technology equipment / IT equipment disposal / Disposal of IT equipment
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0317
controls.description: At least three pages of random text with no blank areas are printed on each colour printer cartridge or MFD print drum.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0317
controls.category: Guidelines for information technology equipment / IT equipment sanitisation and destruction / Sanitising printers and multifunction devices
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0318
controls.description: When unable to sanitise printer cartridges or MFD print drums, they are destroyed as per electrostatic memory devices.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0318
controls.category: Guidelines for information technology equipment / IT equipment sanitisation and destruction / Sanitising printers and multifunction devices
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0321
controls.description: When disposing of IT equipment that has been designed or modified to meet emanation security standards, ASD is contacted for requirements relating to its disposal.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0321
controls.category: Guidelines for information technology equipment / IT equipment disposal / Disposal of IT equipment
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0323
controls.description: Media is classified to the highest sensitivity or classification of data it stores, unless the media has been classified to a higher sensitivity or classification.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0323
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media usage / Classifying media
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0325
controls.description: Any media connected to a system with a higher sensitivity or classification than the media is reclassified to the higher sensitivity or classification, unless the media is read-only or the system has a mechanism through which read-only access can be ensured.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0325
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media usage / Reclassifying media
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0330
controls.description: Before reclassifying media to a lower sensitivity or classification, the media is sanitised or destroyed, and a formal administrative decision is made to reclassify it.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0330
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media usage / Reclassifying media
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0332
controls.description: Media, with the exception of internally mounted fixed media within information technology equipment, is labelled with protective markings reflecting its sensitivity or classification.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0332
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media usage / Labelling media
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0336
controls.description: A networked IT equipment register is developed, implemented, maintained and verified on a regular basis.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0336
controls.category: Guidelines for information technology equipment / IT equipment usage / IT equipment registers
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0337
controls.description: Media is only used with systems that are authorised to process, store or communicate its sensitivity or classification.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0337
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media usage / Classifying media
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0341
controls.description: Automatic execution features for removable media are disabled.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0341
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Operating system hardening / Hardening operating system configurations
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0343
controls.description: If there is no business requirement for writing to removable media and devices, such functionality is disabled via the use of a device access control application or by disabling external communication interfaces.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0343
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Operating system hardening / Device access control
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0345
controls.description: External communication interfaces that allow DMA are disabled.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0345
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Operating system hardening / Device access control
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0347
controls.description: When transferring data manually between two systems belonging to different security domains, write-once media is used unless the destination system has a mechanism through which read-only access can be ensured.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0347
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media usage / Using media for data transfers
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0348
controls.description: Media sanitisation processes, and supporting media sanitisation procedures, are developed, implemented and maintained.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0348
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media sanitisation / Media sanitisation processes and procedures
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0350
controls.description: The following media types are destroyed prior to their disposal: - microfiche and microfilm - optical discs - programmable read-only memory - read-only memory - other types of media that cannot be sanitised.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0350
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media destruction / Media that cannot be sanitised
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0351
controls.description: Volatile media is sanitised by removing its power for at least 10 minutes.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0351
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media sanitisation / Volatile media sanitisation
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0352
controls.description: SECRET and TOP SECRET volatile media is sanitised by overwriting it at least once in its entirety with a random pattern followed by a read back for verification.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0352
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media sanitisation / Volatile media sanitisation
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0354
controls.description: Non-volatile magnetic media is sanitised by overwriting it at least once (or three times if pre-2001 or under 15 GB) in its entirety with a random pattern followed by a read back for verification.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0354
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media sanitisation / Non-volatile magnetic media sanitisation
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0356
controls.description: Following sanitisation, SECRET and TOP SECRET non-volatile magnetic media retains its classification.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0356
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media sanitisation / Treatment of non-volatile magnetic media following sanitisation
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0357
controls.description: Non-volatile EPROM media is sanitised by applying three times the manufacturer's specified ultraviolet erasure time and then overwriting it at least once in its entirety with a random pattern followed by a read back for verification.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0357
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media sanitisation / Non-volatile erasable programmable read-only memory media sanitisation
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0358
controls.description: Following sanitisation, SECRET and TOP SECRET non-volatile EPROM and EEPROM media retains its classification.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0358
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media sanitisation / Treatment of non-volatile erasable and electrically erasable programmable read-only memory media following sanitisation
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0359
controls.description: Non-volatile flash memory media is sanitised by overwriting it at least twice in its entirety with a random pattern followed by a read back for verification.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0359
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media sanitisation / Non-volatile flash memory media sanitisation
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0360
controls.description: Following sanitisation, SECRET and TOP SECRET non-volatile flash memory media retains its classification.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0360
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media sanitisation / Treatment of non-volatile flash memory media following sanitisation
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0361
controls.description: Magnetic media is destroyed using a degausser with a suitable magnetic field strength and magnetic orientation.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0361
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media destruction / Degaussing magnetic media
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0362
controls.description: Product-specific directions provided by degausser manufacturers are followed.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0362
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media destruction / Degaussing magnetic media
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0363
controls.description: Media destruction processes, and supporting media destruction procedures, are developed, implemented and maintained.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0363
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media destruction / Media destruction processes and procedures
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0368
controls.description: Media destroyed using a hammer mill, disintegrator, grinder/sander or by cutting results in media waste particles no larger than 9 mm.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0368
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media destruction / Media destruction methods
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0370
controls.description: The destruction of media is performed under the supervision of at least one cleared person.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0370
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media destruction / Supervision of destruction
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0371
controls.description: Personnel supervising the destruction of media supervise its handling to the point of destruction and ensure that the destruction is completed successfully.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0371
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media destruction / Supervision of destruction
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0372
controls.description: The destruction of media storing accountable material is performed under the supervision of at least two cleared personnel.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0372
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media destruction / Supervision of accountable material destruction
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0373
controls.description: Personnel supervising the destruction of media storing accountable material supervise its handling to the point of destruction, ensure that the destruction is completed successfully and sign a destruction certificate afterwards.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0373
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media destruction / Supervision of accountable material destruction
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0374
controls.description: Media disposal processes, and supporting media disposal procedures, are developed, implemented and maintained.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0374
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media disposal / Media disposal processes and procedures
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0375
controls.description: Following sanitisation, destruction or declassification, a formal administrative decision is made to release media, or its waste, into the public domain.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0375
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media disposal / Disposal of media
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0378
controls.description: Labels and markings indicating the owner, sensitivity, classification or any other marking that can associate media with its prior use are removed prior to its disposal.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0378
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media disposal / Disposal of media
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0380
controls.description: Unneeded user accounts, components, services and functionality of operating systems are disabled or removed.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0380
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Operating system hardening / Hardening operating system configurations
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0382
controls.description: Unprivileged users do not have the ability to uninstall or disable approved applications.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0382
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Operating system hardening / Application management
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0383
controls.description: Default user accounts or credentials for operating systems, including for any pre-configured user accounts, are changed, disabled or removed during initial setup.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0383
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Operating system hardening / Hardening operating system configurations
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0385
controls.description: Servers maintain effective functional separation with other servers allowing them to operate independently.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0385
controls.category: Guidelines for networking / Network design and configuration / Functional separation between servers
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0393
controls.description: Databases and their contents are classified based on the sensitivity or classification of data that they contain.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0393
controls.category: Guidelines for database systems / Databases / Protecting database contents
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0400
controls.description: Development, testing, staging and production environments are segregated.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0400
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Development, testing, staging and production environments
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0401
controls.description: Secure by Design principles and practices are followed throughout the software development life cycle.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0401
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0402
controls.description: Software is comprehensively tested for vulnerabilities, using SAST, DAST and SCA prior to its initial release, any subsequent releases and periodically in order to attempt to identify any previously unidentified vulnerabilities.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0402
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Software security testing
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0405
controls.family: Access to systems and their resources
controls.description: Requests for unprivileged access to systems and their resources are validated when first requested.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0405
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Access to systems and their resources / Unprivileged access to systems
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0407
controls.family: Access to systems and their resources
controls.description: A secure record is maintained for the life of systems and their resources that covers the following for each user: - their user identification - their signed agreement to abide by system usage policies - who authorised their access - when their access was granted - the level of access they were granted - when their access, and their level of access, was last reviewed - when their level of access was changed, and to what extent (if applicable) - when their access was withdrawn (if applicable).
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0407
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Access to systems and their resources / Recording authorisation for personnel to access systems
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0408
controls.description: Systems have a logon banner that reminds users of their security responsibilities when accessing the system and its resources.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0408
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Authentication hardening / Logon banner
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0409
controls.family: Access to systems and their resources
controls.description: Foreign nationals, including seconded foreign nationals, do not have access to systems that process, store or communicate AUSTEO or REL data unless effective controls are in place to ensure such data is not accessible to them.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0409
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Access to systems and their resources / Unprivileged access to systems by foreign nationals
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0411
controls.family: Access to systems and their resources
controls.description: Foreign nationals, excluding seconded foreign nationals, do not have access to systems that process, store or communicate AGAO data unless effective controls are in place to ensure such data is not accessible to them.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0411
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Access to systems and their resources / Unprivileged access to systems by foreign nationals
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0414
controls.family: Access to systems and their resources
controls.description: Personnel granted access to systems and their resources are uniquely identifiable.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0414
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Access to systems and their resources / User identification
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0415
controls.family: Access to systems and their resources
controls.description: The use of shared user accounts is strictly controlled, and personnel using such accounts are uniquely identifiable.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0415
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Access to systems and their resources / User identification
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0417
controls.description: When systems cannot support multi-factor authentication, single-factor authentication using passwords is implemented instead.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0417
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Authentication hardening / Single-factor authentication
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0418
controls.description: Physical credentials are kept separate from systems they are used to authenticate to, except for when performing authentication activities.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0418
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Authentication hardening / Protecting credentials
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0420
controls.family: Access to systems and their resources
controls.description: Where systems process, store or communicate AUSTEO, AGAO or REL data, personnel who are foreign nationals are identified as such, including by their specific nationality.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0420
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Access to systems and their resources / User identification
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0421
controls.description: Passwords used for single-factor authentication on non-classified, OFFICIAL: Sensitive and PROTECTED systems are a minimum of 15 characters.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0421
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Authentication hardening / Password strength
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P

controls.title: Control: ism-0422
controls.description: Passwords used for single-factor authentication on TOP SECRET systems are a minimum of 20 characters.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0422
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Authentication hardening / Password strength
controls.applicability_notes: TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0428
controls.description: Services are configured with a session lock that: - activates after a maximum of 15 minutes of user inactivity, a maximum of 12 hours of overall session time or when manually activated by users - blocks access to all session content - requires users to re-authenticate using all authentication factors to unlock the session - denies users the ability to disable the session locking mechanism.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0428
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Authentication hardening / Session locking
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0430
controls.family: Access to systems and their resources
controls.description: Access to systems and their resources are removed or suspended the same day personnel no longer have a legitimate requirement for access.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0430
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Access to systems and their resources / Suspension of access to systems
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0432
controls.family: Access to systems and their resources
controls.description: Access requirements for systems and their resources are documented in their system security plan.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0432
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Access to systems and their resources / System access requirements
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0434
controls.family: Access to systems and their resources
controls.description: Personnel undergo appropriate employment screening and, where necessary, hold an appropriate security clearance before being granted access to systems and their resources.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0434
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Access to systems and their resources / System access requirements
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0435
controls.family: Access to systems and their resources
controls.description: Personnel receive any necessary briefings before being granted access to systems and their resources.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0435
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Access to systems and their resources / System access requirements
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0441
controls.family: Access to systems and their resources
controls.description: When personnel are granted temporary access to systems and their resources, effective controls are put in place to restrict their access to only data required for them to undertake their duties.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0441
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Access to systems and their resources / Temporary access to systems
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0443
controls.family: Access to systems and their resources
controls.description: Temporary access is not granted to systems that process, store or communicate caveated or sensitive compartmented information.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0443
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Access to systems and their resources / Temporary access to systems
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0445
controls.family: Access to systems and their resources
controls.description: Privileged users are assigned a dedicated privileged user account to be used solely for duties requiring privileged access.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0445
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Access to systems and their resources / Privileged access to systems
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0446
controls.family: Access to systems and their resources
controls.description: Foreign nationals, including seconded foreign nationals, do not have privileged access to systems that process, store or communicate AUSTEO or REL data.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0446
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Access to systems and their resources / Privileged access to systems by foreign nationals
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0447
controls.family: Access to systems and their resources
controls.description: Foreign nationals, excluding seconded foreign nationals, do not have privileged access to systems that process, store or communicate AGAO data.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0447
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Access to systems and their resources / Privileged access to systems by foreign nationals
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0455
controls.description: Where practical, cryptographic equipment, applications and libraries provide a means of data recovery to allow for circumstances where the encryption key is unavailable due to loss, damage or failure.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0455
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Cryptographic fundamentals / Data recovery
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0457
controls.description: Cryptographic equipment, applications or libraries that have completed a Common Criteria evaluation against an ASD-endorsed Protection Profile are used when encrypting media that contains OFFICIAL: Sensitive or PROTECTED data.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0457
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Cryptographic fundamentals / Cryptographic implementation assurance
controls.applicability_notes: OS, P

controls.title: Control: ism-0459
controls.description: Full disk encryption, or partial encryption where access controls will only allow writing to the encrypted partition, is implemented when encrypting data at rest.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0459
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Cryptographic fundamentals / Encrypting data at rest
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0460
controls.description: HACE is used when encrypting media that contains SECRET or TOP SECRET data.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0460
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Cryptographic fundamentals / Cryptographic implementation assurance
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0462
controls.description: When a user authenticates to the encryption functionality of IT equipment or media, it is treated in accordance with its original sensitivity or classification until the user deauthenticates from the encryption functionality.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0462
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Cryptographic fundamentals / Handling encrypted IT equipment and media
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0465
