controls.description: Cryptographic equipment, applications or libraries that have completed a Common Criteria evaluation against an ASD-endorsed Protection Profile are used to protect OFFICIAL: Sensitive or PROTECTED data when communicated over insufficiently secure networks, outside of appropriately secure areas or via public network infrastructure.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0465
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Cryptographic fundamentals / Cryptographic implementation assurance
controls.applicability_notes: OS, P

controls.title: Control: ism-0467
controls.description: HACE is used to protect SECRET and TOP SECRET data when communicated over insufficiently secure networks, outside of appropriately secure areas or via public network infrastructure.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0467
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Cryptographic fundamentals / Cryptographic implementation assurance
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0469
controls.description: An ASD-Approved Cryptographic Protocol (AACP) or high assurance cryptographic protocol is used to protect data when communicated over network infrastructure.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0469
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Cryptographic fundamentals / Encrypting data in transit
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0471
controls.description: Only AACAs or high assurance cryptographic algorithms are used by cryptographic equipment, applications and libraries.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0471
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / ASD-Approved Cryptographic Algorithms / Using ASD-Approved Cryptographic Algorithms
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0472
controls.description: When using DH for agreeing on encryption session keys, a modulus of at least 2048 bits is used, preferably 3072 bits.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0472
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / ASD-Approved Cryptographic Algorithms / Using Diffie-Hellman
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P

controls.title: Control: ism-0474
controls.description: When using ECDH for agreeing on encryption session keys, a base point order and key size of at least 224 bits is used, preferably the NIST P-384 curve.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0474
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / ASD-Approved Cryptographic Algorithms / Using Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P

controls.title: Control: ism-0475
controls.description: When using ECDSA for digital signatures, a base point order and key size of at least 224 bits is used, preferably the P-384 curve.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0475
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / ASD-Approved Cryptographic Algorithms / Using the Elliptic Curve Digital Signature Algorithm
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P

controls.title: Control: ism-0476
controls.description: When using RSA for digital signatures, and transporting encryption session keys (and similar keys), a modulus of at least 2048 bits is used, preferably 3072 bits.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0476
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / ASD-Approved Cryptographic Algorithms / Using Rivest-Shamir-Adleman
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P

controls.title: Control: ism-0477
controls.description: When using RSA for digital signatures, and for transporting encryption session keys (and similar keys), a different key pair is used for digital signatures and transporting encryption session keys.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0477
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / ASD-Approved Cryptographic Algorithms / Using Rivest-Shamir-Adleman
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0479
controls.description: Symmetric cryptographic algorithms are not used in Electronic Codebook Mode.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0479
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / ASD-Approved Cryptographic Algorithms / Using symmetric cryptographic algorithms
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0481
controls.description: Only AACPs or high assurance cryptographic protocols are used by cryptographic equipment, applications and libraries.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0481
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / ASD-Approved Cryptographic Protocols / Using ASD-Approved Cryptographic Protocols
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0484
controls.description: The SSH daemon is configured to: - only listen on the required interfaces (ListenAddress xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx) - have a suitable login banner (Banner x) - have a login authentication timeout of no more than 60 seconds (LoginGraceTime 60) - disable host-based authentication (HostbasedAuthentication no) - disable rhosts-based authentication (IgnoreRhosts yes) - disable the ability to login directly as root (PermitRootLogin no) - disable empty passwords (PermitEmptyPasswords no) - disable connection forwarding (AllowTCPForwarding no) - disable gateway ports (GatewayPorts no) - disable X11 forwarding (X11Forwarding no).
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0484
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Secure Shell / Configuring Secure Shell
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0485
controls.description: Public key-based authentication is used for SSH connections.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0485
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Secure Shell / Authentication mechanisms
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0487
controls.description: When using logins without a password for SSH connections, the following are disabled: - access from IP addresses that do not require access - port forwarding - agent credential forwarding - X11 forwarding - console access.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0487
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Secure Shell / Automated remote access
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0488
controls.description: If using remote access without the use of a password for SSH connections, the 'forced command' option is used to specify what command is executed and parameter checking is enabled.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0488
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Secure Shell / Automated remote access
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0489
controls.description: When SSH-agent or similar key caching applications are used, it is limited to workstations and servers with screen locks and key caches that are set to expire within four hours of inactivity.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0489
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Secure Shell / SSH-agent
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0490
controls.description: Versions of S/MIME earlier than S/MIME version 3.0 are not used for S/MIME connections.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0490
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Secure/Multipurpose Internet Mail Extension / Configuring Secure/Multipurpose Internet Mail Extension
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0494
controls.description: Tunnel mode is used for IPsec connections; however, if using transport mode, an IP tunnel is used.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0494
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Internet Protocol Security / Mode of operation
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0496
controls.description: The ESP protocol is used for authentication and encryption of IPsec connections.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0496
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Internet Protocol Security / Protocol selection
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0498
controls.description: A security association lifetime of less than four hours (14400 seconds) is used for IPsec connections.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0498
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Internet Protocol Security / Security association lifetimes
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0499
controls.description: Communications security doctrine and policy produced by ASD for the management and operation of HACE is complied with.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0499
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Cryptographic fundamentals / Communications security doctrine
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0501
controls.description: Keyed cryptographic equipment is transported based on the sensitivity or classification of its keying material.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0501
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Cryptographic fundamentals / Transporting cryptographic equipment
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0507
controls.description: Cryptographic key management processes, and supporting cryptographic key management procedures, are developed, implemented and maintained.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0507
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Cryptographic fundamentals / Cryptographic key management processes and procedures
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0516
controls.description: Network documentation includes high-level network diagrams showing all connections into networks and logical network diagrams showing all critical servers, high-value servers, network devices and network security appliances.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0516
controls.category: Guidelines for networking / Network design and configuration / Network documentation
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0518
controls.description: Network documentation is developed, implemented and maintained.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0518
controls.category: Guidelines for networking / Network design and configuration / Network documentation
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0520
controls.description: Network access controls are implemented on networks to prevent the connection of unauthorised network devices and networked IT equipment.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0520
controls.category: Guidelines for networking / Network design and configuration / Network access controls
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0521
controls.description: IPv6 functionality is disabled in dual-stack network devices unless it is being used.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0521
controls.category: Guidelines for networking / Network design and configuration / Using Internet Protocol version 6
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0529
controls.description: VLANs are not used to separate network traffic between networks belonging to different security domains.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0529
controls.category: Guidelines for networking / Network design and configuration / Using Virtual Local Area Networks
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0530
controls.description: Network devices managing VLANs are administered from the most trusted security domain.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0530
controls.category: Guidelines for networking / Network design and configuration / Using Virtual Local Area Networks
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0534
controls.description: Unused physical ports on network devices are disabled.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0534
controls.category: Guidelines for networking / Network design and configuration / Disabling unused physical ports on network devices
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0535
controls.description: Network devices managing VLANs belonging to different security domains do not share VLAN trunks.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0535
controls.category: Guidelines for networking / Network design and configuration / Using Virtual Local Area Networks
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0536
controls.description: Public wireless networks provided for general public use are segregated from all other organisation networks.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0536
controls.category: Guidelines for networking / Wireless networks / Public wireless networks
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0546
controls.family: Video conferencing and Internet Protocol telephony
controls.description: When video conferencing or IP telephony traffic passes through a gateway containing a firewall or proxy, a video-aware or voice-aware firewall or proxy is used.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0546
controls.category: Guidelines for communications systems / Video conferencing and Internet Protocol telephony / Video-aware and voice-aware firewalls and proxies
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0547
controls.family: Video conferencing and Internet Protocol telephony
controls.description: Video conferencing and IP telephony calls are conducted using a secure real-time transport protocol.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0547
controls.category: Guidelines for communications systems / Video conferencing and Internet Protocol telephony / Protecting video conferencing and Internet Protocol telephony traffic
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0548

controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Cyber security awareness training / Reporting suspicious contact via online services
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Cyber security awareness training / Posting work information to online services

controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Cyber security awareness training / Posting personal information to online services
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Cyber security awareness training / Sending and receiving files via online services
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0829
controls.description: Security measures are used to detect and respond to unauthorised RF devices in SECRET and TOP SECRET areas.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0829
controls.category: Guidelines for physical security / Facilities and systems / Bringing radio frequency and infrared devices into facilities
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0831
controls.description: Media is handled in a manner suitable for its sensitivity or classification.

controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media usage / Handling media
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.description: Following sanitisation, TOP SECRET volatile media retains its classification if it stored static data for an extended period of time, or had data repeatedly stored on or written to the same memory location for an extended period of time.

controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media sanitisation / Treatment of volatile media following sanitisation

controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media sanitisation / Non-volatile electrically erasable programmable read-only memory media sanitisation
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0839
controls.description: The destruction of media storing accountable material is not outsourced.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0839
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media destruction / Outsourcing media destruction
controls.applicability_notes: OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0840
controls.description: When outsourcing the destruction of media storing non-accountable material, a National Association for Information Destruction AAA certified destruction service with endorsements, as specified in ASIO's Protective Security Circular-167, is used.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0840
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media destruction / Outsourcing media destruction
controls.applicability_notes: OS, P, S

controls.title: Control: ism-0843
controls.description: Application control is implemented on workstations.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0843
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Operating system hardening / Application control
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0846
controls.description: All users (with the exception of local administrator accounts and break glass accounts) cannot disable, bypass or be exempted from application control.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0846
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Operating system hardening / Application control
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0853
controls.description: On a daily basis, outside of business hours and after an appropriate period of inactivity, user sessions are terminated and workstations are restarted.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0853
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Authentication hardening / Session termination
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0854
controls.family: Access to systems and their resources
controls.description: AUSTEO and AGAO data can only be accessed from systems under the sole control of the Australian Government that are located within facilities authorised by the Australian Government.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0854
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Access to systems and their resources / Control of Australian systems
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0861
controls.description: DKIM signing is enabled on emails originating from an organisation's domains (including subdomains).
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0861
controls.category: Guidelines for email / Email gateways and servers / DomainKeys Identified Mail
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0863
controls.description: Mobile devices prevent personnel from installing non-approved applications once provisioned.

controls.category: Guidelines for enterprise mobility / Mobile device management / Maintaining mobile device security
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0864
controls.description: Mobile devices prevent personnel from disabling or modifying security functionality once provisioned.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0864
controls.category: Guidelines for enterprise mobility / Mobile device management / Maintaining mobile device security
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.description: Sensitive or classified data is not viewed on mobile devices in public locations unless care is taken to reduce the chance of the screen of a mobile device being observed.

controls.category: Guidelines for enterprise mobility / Mobile device usage / Using mobile devices in public spaces
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0869

controls.category: Guidelines for enterprise mobility / Mobile device management / Data storage
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0870
controls.description: Mobile devices are carried or stored in a secured state when not being actively used.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0870
controls.category: Guidelines for enterprise mobility / Mobile device usage / Maintaining control of mobile devices
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0871
controls.description: Mobile devices are kept under continual direct supervision when being actively used.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0871
controls.category: Guidelines for enterprise mobility / Mobile device usage / Maintaining control of mobile devices
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0874

controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0874
controls.category: Guidelines for enterprise mobility / Enterprise mobility / Mobile devices and desktop computers accessing the internet
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0888

controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0912
controls.description: Systems have a change and configuration management plan that includes: - the establishment and maintenance of authorised baseline configurations for systems - what constitutes routine and urgent changes to the configuration of systems - how changes to the configuration of systems will be requested, tracked and documented - who needs to be consulted prior to routine and urgent changes to the configuration of systems - who needs to approve routine and urgent changes to the configuration of systems - who needs to be notified of routine and urgent changes to the configuration of systems - what additional change management and configuration management processes and procedures need to be followed before, during and after routine and urgent changes to the configuration of systems.

controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0917
controls.description: When malicious code is detected, the following steps are taken to handle the infection: - the infected systems are isolated - all previously connected media used in the period leading up to the infection are scanned for signs of infection and isolated if necessary - antivirus applications are used to remove the infection from infected systems and media - if the infection cannot be reliably removed, systems are restored from a known good backup or rebuilt.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0917
controls.category: Guidelines for cyber security incidents / Responding to cyber security incidents / Handling and containing malicious code infections
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0926
controls.description: Non-classified, OFFICIAL: Sensitive and PROTECTED cables are coloured neither salmon pink nor red.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0926
controls.category: Guidelines for communications infrastructure / Cabling infrastructure / Cable colours
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P

controls.title: Control: ism-0931
controls.description: In SECRET and TOP SECRET areas, push-to-talk handsets or push-to-talk headsets are used to meet any off-hook audio protection requirements.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0931
controls.category: Guidelines for communications systems / Telephone systems / Off-hook audio protection
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0938
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / User application hardening / User application selection
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-0947
controls.description: When transferring data manually between two systems belonging to different security domains, rewritable media is sanitised after each data transfer.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0947
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media usage / Using media for data transfers
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0955
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Operating system hardening / Application control
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0961
controls.category: Guidelines for gateways / Web content filters / Using web content filters
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0963
controls.category: Guidelines for gateways / Web content filters / Using web content filters
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Web application development / Secure web application design and development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-0974
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Authentication hardening / Multi-factor authentication
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / ASD-Approved Cryptographic Algorithms / Asymmetric cryptographic algorithms
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Internet Protocol Security / Diffie-Hellman groups
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Internet Protocol Security / Perfect Forward Secrecy
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.category: Guidelines for networking / Network design and configuration / Network management traffic
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.category: Guidelines for networking / Wireless networks / Wireless network footprint
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.category: Guidelines for communications systems / Video conferencing and Internet Protocol telephony / Video conferencing unit and Internet Protocol phone authentication
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.description: A denial of service response plan for video conferencing and IP telephony services is developed, implemented and maintained.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-1019
controls.category: Guidelines for communications systems / Video conferencing and Internet Protocol telephony / Denial of service response plan
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.category: Guidelines for email / Email usage / Handling emails with inappropriate, invalid or missing protective markings
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.category: Guidelines for email / Email gateways and servers / Notifications of undeliverable emails
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.category: Guidelines for networking / Network design and configuration / Using Network-based Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Operating system hardening / Host-based intrusion detection and response solution
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.category: Guidelines for gateways / Gateways / Assessment of gateways
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.category: Guidelines for physical security / Facilities and systems / Physical access to servers, network devices and cryptographic equipment
controls.applicability_notes: OS, P, S, TS

controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Authentication hardening / Insecure authentication methods
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-1059
controls.description: All data stored on media is encrypted.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-1059
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media usage / Handling media
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.description: The host-protected area and device configuration overlay table are reset prior to the sanitisation of non-volatile magnetic hard drives.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-1065
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media sanitisation / Non-volatile magnetic media sanitisation
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.description: The ATA secure erase command is used, in addition to block overwriting software, to ensure the growth defects table of non-volatile magnetic hard drives is overwritten.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-1067
controls.category: Guidelines for media / Media sanitisation / Non-volatile magnetic media sanitisation
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-1071

controls.category: Guidelines for cyber security roles / System owners / System ownership and oversight
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.category: Guidelines for procurement and outsourcing / Managed services and cloud services / Access to systems by service providers
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-1074

controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-1074
controls.category: Guidelines for physical security / Facilities and systems / Physical access to servers, network devices and cryptographic equipment
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-1076
controls.description: Televisions and computer monitors with minor burn-in or image persistence are sanitised by displaying a solid white image on the screen for an extended period of time.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-1076
controls.category: Guidelines for information technology equipment / IT equipment sanitisation and destruction / Sanitising televisions and computer monitors
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-1078
controls.description: A telephone system usage policy is developed, implemented and maintained.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-1078
controls.category: Guidelines for communications systems / Telephone systems / Telephone system usage policy
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-1079
controls.description: ASD's approval is sought before undertaking any maintenance or repairs to high assurance IT equipment.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-1079
controls.category: Guidelines for information technology equipment / IT equipment maintenance and repairs / Maintenance and repairs of high assurance IT equipment
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-1080
controls.description: An ASD-Approved Cryptographic Algorithm (AACA) or high assurance cryptographic algorithm is used when encrypting media.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-1080
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Cryptographic fundamentals / Encrypting data at rest
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-1082
controls.description: A mobile device usage policy is developed, implemented and maintained.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-1082
controls.category: Guidelines for enterprise mobility / Mobile device usage / Mobile device usage policy
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-1083
controls.category: Guidelines for enterprise mobility / Mobile device usage / Personnel awareness
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-1084
controls.description: If unable to carry or store mobile devices in a secured state, they are physically transferred in a security briefcase or an approved multi-use satchel, pouch or transit bag.

controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.description: Mobile devices encrypt all sensitive or classified data communicated over public network infrastructure.

controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-1091
controls.description: Keying material is changed when compromised or suspected of being compromised.

controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / Cryptographic fundamentals / Reporting cryptographic-related cyber security incidents
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-1095

controls.title: Control: ism-1554

controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P

controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Authentication hardening / Password strength

controls.description: An authoritative source for software is established and maintained.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2023
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Authoritative source for software
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2024
controls.description: The authoritative source for software is used for all software development activities.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2024
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Authoritative source for software
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2025
controls.description: An issue tracking solution is used to link software development tasks to security issues and decisions, change or feature requests, programming issues, or bug fixes.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2025
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Issue tracking
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2026
controls.description: All software artefacts are scanned for malicious content before being imported into the authoritative source for software.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2026
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Software artefacts
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2027
controls.description: All software artefacts are verified by a digital signature, or a secure hash provided over a secure channel, before being imported into the authoritative source for software.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2027
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Software artefacts
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2028
controls.description: All software artefacts are tested to detect known weaknesses using static application security testing (SAST), dynamic application security testing (DAST) or software composition analysis (SCA), depending on the software artefact type, before being imported into the authoritative source for software.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2028
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Software artefacts
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2029
controls.description: The authoritative source for software restricts the use and import of third-party libraries and software components to trustworthy sources.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2029
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Software artefacts
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2030
controls.description: Scanning is used during commits to identify plain text or encoded secrets and keys, which are then blocked from being stored in the authoritative source for software.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2030
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Software artefacts
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2031
controls.description: Compilers, interpreters and build tools (including pipelines) that provide security features to improve executable file security are implemented and such security features are used.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2031
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Build solution
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2032
controls.description: The build solution ensures that all automated testing is completed without warnings, alerts or errors before building software artefacts.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2032
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Build solution
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2033
controls.description: All software security requirements are documented, stored securely and maintained throughout the software development life cycle.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2033
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2034
controls.description: Security design decisions are documented and reviewed throughout the software development cycle.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2034
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2035
controls.description: Security roles, responsibilities and knowledge requirements required to support the software development life cycle are identified and documented.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2035
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2036
controls.description: Security responsibilities for software developers are identified and documented.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2036
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2037
controls.description: Software developers that lack sufficient cyber security knowledge and skills required for their projects or tasks undertake suitable training on secure software development and programming practices.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2037
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2038
controls.description: A software developer cyber security knowledge and skills register is implemented and maintained.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2038
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2039
controls.description: The software threat model is reviewed throughout the software development life cycle to ensure it reflects the as-built software and any changes to the threat environment.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2039
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2040
controls.description: Secure programming practices for the chosen programming language are used for software development.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2040
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2041
controls.description: Memory-safe programming languages, or less preferably memory-safe programming practices, are used for software development.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2041
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2042
controls.description: Secure by Default principles and practices are followed throughout the software development life cycle, including by ensuring that all built-in security measures are included and enabled in the base product at no extra cost to consumers.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2042
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2043
controls.description: Software is architected and structured to support readability and maintainability.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2043
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2044
controls.description: Software has no default credentials; however, if credentials are required, they are created on first install by the installing organisation.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2044
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2045
controls.description: Application backwards compatibility does not compromise any security measures or features.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2045
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2046
controls.description: Where software allows user impersonation, sensitive data is not logged and appropriate permissions are set.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2046
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2047
controls.description: Where software allows an authentication factor to be reset, the user is notified of the reset through a secondary channel.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2047
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2048
controls.description: Where software supports multiple user roles, non-administrative users are prevented from altering their profile permissions or privileges.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2048
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2049
controls.description: When user permissions or credentials are changed, software forces all impacted users to re-authenticate.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2049
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2050
controls.description: When digital signatures are processed by software, they are validated against a certificate trust chain and checked for revocation using a Certificate Revocation List or with the Online Certificate Status Protocol.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2050
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2051
controls.description: Software generates sufficient event logs to support the detection of cyber security events.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2051
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2052
controls.description: Event logs produced by software ensure that any sensitive data is protected.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2052
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2053
controls.description: End of life procedures for software, covering how to remove the software and how to archive or destroy any user accounts and data, are produced and made available to consumers.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2053
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Secure software development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2054
controls.description: If a software bill of materials is available for imported third-party software components, it is used during software development to ensure such software components have no known vulnerabilities.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2054
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Software bill of materials
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2055
controls.description: If a software build provenance is available for imported third-party software components, it is used during software development to ensure such software components are built to an appropriate standard.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2055
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Software build provenance
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2056
controls.description: A software build provenance is produced and made available to consumers of software.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2056
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Software build provenance
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2057
controls.description: All input validation rules are documented, matched in code and tested with both positive and negative unit testing or integration testing.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2057
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Software input handling
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2058
controls.description: Data sources and serialised data inputs are validated before being deserialised.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2058
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Software input handling
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2059
controls.description: File uploads or input are restricted to specific file types, with malicious content scanning occurring prior to file access, file execution or file storage.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2059
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Software input handling
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2060
controls.description: Code reviews are utilised to ensure software meets Secure by Design principles and practices as well as secure programming practices.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2060
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Software security testing
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2061
controls.description: Software developer-supported security-focused peer reviews are conducted on all critical and security-focused software components.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2061
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Software security testing
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2062
controls.description: Unit testing and integration testing, covering both positive and negative use cases, are used to ensure code quality and security.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2062
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Software security testing
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2063
controls.description: If supported, web application session cookies set the HttpOnly flag, Secure flag and the SameSite flag by default.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2063
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Web application development / Secure web application design and development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2064
controls.description: Web application session cookies contain only digitally signed opaque bearer tokens.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2064
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Web application development / Secure web application design and development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2065
controls.description: Web application session cookies using opaque bearer tokens that are not digitally signed use non-sequential random identifiers with a minimum of 128 bits of entropy, preferably 256 bits of entropy.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2065
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Web application development / Secure web application design and development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2066
controls.description: Web application sessions are centrally managed server side.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2066
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Web application development / Secure web application design and development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2067
controls.description: Web applications that support Single Sign On equally support Single Logout.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2067
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Web application development / Secure web application design and development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2068
controls.description: Internet connectivity for networked devices is strictly limited to those that require access.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2068
controls.category: Guidelines for networking / Network design and configuration / Functional separation between networked devices and the internet
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2069
controls.description: An authorised photographic and video recording device register for SECRET and TOP SECRET areas is developed, implemented, maintained and verified on a regular basis.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2069
controls.category: Guidelines for physical security / Facilities and systems / Bringing photographic and video recording devices into facilities
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2070
controls.description: Unauthorised photographic and video recording devices are not brought into SECRET and TOP SECRET areas.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2070
controls.category: Guidelines for physical security / Facilities and systems / Bringing photographic and video recording devices into facilities
controls.applicability_notes: S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2071
controls.description: Personnel dealing with user account details are advised of what social engineering attacks are, how to manage such situations and how to report them.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2071
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Cyber security awareness training / Managing and reporting suspicious requests to disclose or change user account details
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2072
controls.description: Artificial intelligence models are stored in a non-executable file format that does not allow arbitrary code execution.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2072
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Artificial intelligence application development / Secure artificial intelligence application development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2073
controls.description: A post-quantum cryptography transition plan is developed, implemented and maintained.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2073
controls.category: Guidelines for cryptography / ASD-Approved Cryptographic Algorithms / Transitioning to post-quantum cryptography
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2074
controls.family: Access to systems and their resources
controls.description: A general-purpose artificial intelligence usage policy is developed, implemented and maintained.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2074
controls.category: Guidelines for personnel security / Access to systems and their resources / General-purpose artificial intelligence usage policy
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2075
controls.description: Fax machines, and online fax services, are not used for sending or receiving fax messages.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2075
controls.category: Guidelines for communications systems / Fax machines and services / Sending and receiving fax messages
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2076
controls.description: Security questions are not used for authentication purposes.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2076
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Authentication hardening / Insecure authentication methods
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2077
controls.description: Email is not used for out-of-band authentication purposes.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2077
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Authentication hardening / Insecure authentication methods
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2078
controls.description: Passwords appearing in lists of commonly used passwords or lists of compromised passwords are not used.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2078
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Authentication hardening / Password strength
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2079
controls.description: Maximum length limits for passwords are not less than 64 characters.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2079
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Authentication hardening / Password strength
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2080
controls.description: Password complexity requirements are not imposed for passwords.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2080
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Authentication hardening / Password strength
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2081
controls.description: All ASCII printable characters are supported for passwords.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2081
controls.category: Guidelines for system hardening / Authentication hardening / Password strength
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2082
controls.description: If a cryptographic bill of materials is available for imported third-party software components, it is used during software development to ensure such software components provide support for standardised implementations of ASD-Approved Cryptographic Algorithms.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2082
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Cryptographic bill of materials
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2083
controls.description: A cryptographic bill of materials is produced and made available to consumers of software.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2083
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Software development fundamentals / Cryptographic bill of materials
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2084
controls.description: Artificial intelligence-specific documentation, including model and system cards (or equivalent artefacts), is used to document model characteristics, system architectures, use cases and security risks.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2084
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Artificial intelligence application development / Secure artificial intelligence application development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2085
controls.description: The exposure of exact artificial intelligence model confidence scores in API responses or user interfaces is prevented.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2085
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Artificial intelligence application development / Secure artificial intelligence application development
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2086
controls.description: The source and integrity of artificial intelligence models, structures and weights are verified.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2086
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Artificial intelligence application development / Artificial intelligence model poisoning
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2087
controls.description: The source and integrity of training data for artificial intelligence models is verified.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2087
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Artificial intelligence application development / Artificial intelligence model poisoning
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2088
controls.description: Data validation and verification techniques are used to ensure the reliability and accuracy of training data used by artificial intelligence models.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2088
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Artificial intelligence application development / Artificial intelligence model poisoning
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2089
controls.description: Artificial intelligence model performance metrics are monitored and anomalies are investigated.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2089
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Artificial intelligence application development / Unbounded consumption
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2090
controls.description: Rate limiting is applied to inference queries for artificial intelligence models.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2090
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Artificial intelligence application development / Unbounded consumption
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2091
controls.description: Resource limits are enforced for artificial intelligence models.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2091
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Artificial intelligence application development / Unbounded consumption
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2092
controls.description: Access control policies are implemented to enforce fine-grained permissions for artificial intelligence applications.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2092
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Artificial intelligence application development / Excessive agency
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2093
controls.description: Role-based access controls are implemented for artificial intelligence applications to restrict access to sensitive data.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2093
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Artificial intelligence application development / Excessive agency
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2094
controls.description: Content filtering is implemented by artificial intelligence applications to detect and block sensitive data exposure and improper output.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2094
controls.category: Guidelines for software development / Artificial intelligence application development / Sensitive data exposure and improper output
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2095
controls.description: Personnel using privately-owned mobile devices or desktop computers to access OFFICIAL: Sensitive or PROTECTED systems or data are disallowed from granting access to unapproved artificial intelligence agents.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2095
controls.category: Guidelines for enterprise mobility / Enterprise mobility / Privately-owned mobile devices and desktop computers
controls.applicability_notes: OS, P

controls.title: Control: ism-2096
controls.description: Mobile devices are configured to enforce separation between organisational and personal mobile applications and data.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2096
controls.category: Guidelines for enterprise mobility / Mobile device management / Maintaining mobile device security
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2097
controls.description: Mobile devices are configured with always on VPN functionality.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2097
controls.category: Guidelines for enterprise mobility / Mobile device management / Maintaining mobile device security
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2098
controls.description: Mobile devices are configured to prevent data transfers over Universal Serial Bus connections.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2098
controls.category: Guidelines for enterprise mobility / Mobile device management / Maintaining mobile device security
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2099
controls.description: Mobile devices are not connected to the infotainment systems of connected vehicles.
controls.definitions: Source: ACSC ISM OSCAL; OSCAL id: ism-2099
controls.category: Guidelines for enterprise mobility / Mobile device usage / Connecting mobile devices to connected vehicles
controls.applicability_notes: NC, OS, P, S, TS

controls.title: Control: ism-2100
controls.description: Sensitive or classified data is not viewed on mobile devices within or near connected vehicles.

controls.category: Guidelines for enterprise mobility / Mobile device usage / Using mobile devices within or near connected vehicles
